user.title: Add a Kasa TPAP device
user.description: Turn **off** Third-Party Compatibility for the device in the TP-Link Kasa/Tapo app first. Supported: Kasa/Tapo plugs and wall switches, dimmers, energy-monitoring plugs and power strips that use the TPAP login.

pick.title: Devices found on your network
pick.description: Pick a device and enter the TP-Link account that owns it. Your password is sent only to the device, through a password-authenticated key exchange, and is stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage.

data_description.password: If another Kasa TPAP device already uses this account, leave empty to reuse its saved password.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name stored on the device.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the device is polled for its state, in seconds (3–300). Short intervals mean more requests to the device; the LED and auto-off settings are still read only once a minute.

manual.title: Add a device by IP address
manual.description: Connects directly to the device on your local network. Your password is sent only to the device, through a password-authenticated key exchange, and is stored in Home Assistant's configuration storage.

data_description.host: Private LAN IP address of the device, for example 192.168.50.65. Host names are not accepted.
data_description.password: If another Kasa TPAP device already uses this account, leave empty to reuse its saved password.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name stored on the device.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the device is polled for its state, in seconds (3–300). Short intervals mean more requests to the device; the LED and auto-off settings are still read only once a minute.

discovery_confirm.title: Kasa TPAP device found
discovery_confirm.description: A TP-Link device using the TPAP login was found at {host}. Enter the TP-Link account that owns it.

data_description.password: If another Kasa TPAP device already uses this account, leave empty to reuse its saved password.
data_description.name: Leave empty to use the name stored on the device.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the device is polled for its state, in seconds (3–300). Short intervals mean more requests to the device; the LED and auto-off settings are still read only once a minute.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the TP-Link account
reauth_confirm.description: The device at {host} rejected the stored TP-Link credentials.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the device
reconfigure.description: Change the IP address or the TP-Link account. The device must remain the same physical device. Leave the password empty to keep the stored one.

progress.scan: Scanning your network for Kasa TPAP devices. This can take up to a minute.

error.invalid_host: Enter a private LAN IP address (no host names, public, loopback, link-local or multicast addresses).
error.invalid_auth: The device rejected the TP-Link email or password.
error.device_locked: The device has temporarily locked logins after failed attempts. Wait for the lockout to expire (usually 30 minutes or less) before trying again.
error.timeout: The device did not answer in time. Check that it is powered and on the network.
error.cannot_connect: The device is unreachable at this address.
error.tpap_discovery_failed: The device did not answer the TPAP discovery request. Third-Party Compatibility is probably enabled for this device: turn it off in the TP-Link app, wait a minute and try again.
error.unsupported_protocol: The device asks for a mode this integration does not support (TPAP over TLS, a login without the account password, or the legacy Kasa IOT request protocol).
error.confirmation_failed: The device failed to prove that it knows your credentials (PAKE confirmation mismatch). The connection was refused; check that the IP address belongs to your device.
error.protocol_error: The device answered with an unexpected response. Enable debug logging for details.
error.password_required: Enter the password of this TP-Link account.

abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different device than the one configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured TPAP device answered on your network. Check that Third-Party Compatibility is off for the device, or add it by IP address.
abort.not_tpap_device: This device does not use the TPAP login supported by this integration.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the device is polled for its state, in seconds (3–300). Short intervals mean more requests to the device; the LED and auto-off settings are still read only once a minute.

auth_failed.message: The device rejected the stored TP-Link credentials. Re-authenticate the integration.

device_locked.message: The device has temporarily locked logins after failed attempts.
